description:
What is This Part?
This is a Complete 6-Piece Directional Light Set in LED.
Fits: Suzuki Samurai, SJ413 & SJ410.
Set will require a different relay for LED
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – LED Brake Assembly (LH & RH)
Qty 2 – LED Front Turn Assembly (LH & RH)
Qty 2 – LED Front Side Marker Assembly (LH & RH)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
